_doc: Slice #174 — days-to-sell prediction tunables. Pure deterministic predictor: expectedDays = baseline(segment) × priceMult × heatMult × agingMult, clamped to bounds. priceMult/heatMult are exponential so they stay strictly positive and monotonic. Calibrated so at-market → baseline, +20% → ~4x, -10% → 0.5x (priceSensitivity ≈ ln(4)/0.2 ≈ ln(0.5)/-0.1 ≈ 6.93). 'above'/'below' kept separate so #180 can tune asymmetry (above-market overpricing penalty vs below-market acceleration) independently. Confidence falls with extrapolation distance (above-market weighted heavier) and rises with the count of live comps backing the market estimate.
